authentication: Explicit InteractiveBrowserCredential; no CLI, default credential chain, key fallback, or password form.
credentialLifecycle: Single bounded authentication subprocess per CLI invocation; Microsoft browser sign-in at startup, memory-only cache, silent refresh, private pipe.
preflight: Acquire suitable token before claiming queued work so auth failures cannot create provider attempts or need rollback.
transport: Per-image worker receives short-lived token via in-memory spawn IPC; Authorization Bearer only, preserve Azure v1 route and transport protections.
configuration: Opt-in authentication interactive; default api_key preserved; optional validated corporate tenant and public-client application settings.
credentials: No persistence; tokens excluded from repr and explicitly redacted in receiving processes.
scope: Offline implementation and integration proof; no live sign-in, image calls, Entra application provisioning, or git operations.
